test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A single discount equivalent to three simple discounts of 10%, 12% and 15% is:
solution:
**Given:**

The three simple discounts = 10%, 12% and 15%

**Formula used:**

Equivalent discount = [100 – discounted value)/Initial value × 100]

**Calculation:**

Let the initial value be 100

According to the question

Discounted value = (100 – 10)% of (100 – 12)% of (100 – 15)% of 100

⇒ (90/100 × 88/100 × 85/100 × 100)

⇒ (9/10 × 22/25 × 85)

⇒ (9/5 × 11/5 × 17)

⇒ (1683/25)

⇒ 67.32

Equivalent discount = [100 – discounted value)/Initial value × 100]

⇒ [(100 – 67.32)/100 × 100]

⇒ (32.68 × 100)/100

⇒ 32.68%

**∴ A single discount equivalent to the three successive discounts is 32.68%**
